panels.title: E05 · What should I unblock today?
panels.description: Missing input, release R2: no number is shown. Contract: config/panel-contracts/ttv-actions.yaml (panel 1).

options.content:
**Release R2 · missing input.** This card shows no number until the inputs below exist.

**What it will show.** Ranked interventions: the exact action, accountable team and action owner, the unique compatible GPUs it could release (two actions on the same 8 GPUs never count as 16), affected commitments, prerequisites, effort, risk, evidence and an impact range. The ranking dimensions stay visible; the highest AWS rate is not automatically the top priority.

**Missing inputs**

| Input | Where it would come from |
| --- | --- |
| Action ledger: action ID, reason, owner, status (proposed → verified), target date, expected result | Ticket system, or a versioned CSV/YAML import or small API |
| Business priority per project or service | Approved priority list in configuration |
| Effort and risk per action | Entered by the action owner; stays *unknown* when blank |
| Prerequisites between actions (serial blockers) | Links in the action ledger |
| Affected commitments | Commitments register (R3, see Capacity) |

**Onboarding step.** Choose the ticket source or import format, map its fields to action IDs and load the priority list. The engine then links each action to the idle and overdue stage episodes it would clear.

**Answer today (R1).** [Queues](/d/ttv-queues): *Longest waits* lists every idle stage episode with its stage owner, reason, next-action owner and GPU-hours, longest first.

panels.title: E16 · Did our previous decisions actually help?
panels.description: Missing input, release R3: no number is shown. Contract: config/panel-contracts/ttv-actions.yaml (panel 2).

options.content:
**Release R3 · missing input.** This card shows no number until the inputs below exist.

**What it will show.** Each completed action with its baseline, expected result, completion evidence and the result observed over a follow-up window, beside confounders (demand, hardware, software, policy and coverage changes) and recurring blockers. Association in time is labelled separately from a demonstrated cause.

**Missing inputs**

| Input | Where it would come from |
| --- | --- |
| Action ledger with expected result, completion evidence and follow-up window | The E05 ledger (R2), filled in as actions close |
| Baseline and follow-up measure for each action | TTV ledger history: stage durations, idle and overdue GPU-hours |
| Confounders: policy, coverage, demand and hardware changes | Policy versions and scan coverage (ledger); demand from the service graph (R2) |
| Review snapshots to compare against | Frozen review snapshots (R2, with E04 on Home) |

**Onboarding step.** Once the E05 ledger is live, record the expected result and follow-up window when an action is accepted. Verification runs when the window ends; an action without evidence stays unverified.

**Answer today (R1).** [Delivery](/d/ttv-delivery) shows whether stage times are shortening from observed history; [Queues](/d/ttv-queues) shows overdue GPU-hours by stage owner.
